# Directions

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Get driving, traffic-aware driving, or transit directions between points.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/directions",
  "type": "DirectionsOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/directions').par.origin` (an input) and `op('/directions').out.route` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.origin`, `out.route`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `origin` | `Point2DField` | `{"lng":0,"lat":0}` |
| `destination` | `Point2DField` | `{"lng":0,"lat":0}` |
| `mode` | `StringLiteralField` | `"transit"` |
| `departureMode` | `StringLiteralField` | `"now"` |
| `departureTime` | `DateField` |  |
| `trafficModel` | `StringLiteralField` | `"best-guess"` |
| `avoidTolls` | `BooleanField` | `false` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `route` | `CompoundPropsField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
